media.title: Warsaw Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper’s Warsaw years. Includes archival documents, contextual Warsaw images, the 1925 Chopin Music School recital notice, a 1926 Perskie Oko performance photograph, and press items connected with his early musical activity and studies.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s Warsaw years, combining documents, press items and contextual images.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual images relating to Bronisław Kaper’s Warsaw years, including the 1925 Chopin Music School recital, university study, early songwriting traces and Zula Pogorzelska in the 1926 Perskie Oko revue “My chcemy króla.”

media.title: University of Warsaw Gate — law-studies context image
media.description: Historical-context image of the University of Warsaw Gate, used for the 1925 law-studies event. Source route: Szukaj w Archiwach / Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe, unit no. 5985906.
media.altText: Historical view of the entrance gate to the University of Warsaw.
media.rightsNote: Public domain according to the Szukaj w Archiwach / NAC source page recorded for this image. Use with attribution to Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe / Szukaj w Archiwach. This is a contextual image, not evidence of Kaper’s physical presence in the depicted scene.
media.publicCaption: View of the University of Warsaw gate, used as context for Kaper’s law studies at the University of Warsaw in the early 1920s.
media.publicCreditLine: Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe / Szukaj w Archiwach, public domain.
